meta.title: Suggestions
meta.description: Practical next steps grounded in current official sources.
meta.source_rule: Current factual claims link to official sources; unsupported historical price claims are removed.
meta.purpose: Decision improvements for the couple. Each item states the trade-off honestly, says whether it needs a choice before the site/data changes, and estimates the effort.
meta.rule: These are proposals. Nothing here was implemented in the data unless the row says 'implemented'.

suggestions.title: Compare hotel rates by exact dates and room type
suggestions.body: The official rate sample is small and room-category-specific. It does not establish a universally cheapest week or a city-wide best hotel. Compare the same named room category for the exact dates and review the final checkout total, including taxes and fees, before booking.
suggestions.trade_off: The couple's stated preferred arrival is 15 Feb. Moving loses that date but keeps the trip inside the 15 Feb – 23 Mar envelope and buys an extra dinner at a starred restaurant for the same money.

suggestions.title: Resolve whether the trip is three nights or seven nights
suggestions.body: The preferred dates, 15–18 February 2027, are three nights; the hotel comparison is for seven nights. No three-night or fourteen-night official totals are supplied. Ask hotels for the exact length and room category before comparing.
suggestions.trade_off: Three nights cannot cover 21 Michelin restaurants plus the museums — realistically it covers four or five restaurants. Seven nights is the shortest trip where the list is plausible.

suggestions.title: Confirm a queen-or-larger bed and private bathroom in writing
suggestions.body: A room label or bed note alone does not establish every requested room condition. Confirm the actual assigned room includes a queen-or-larger bed and private bathroom before purchase; rates marked assigned-on-arrival are not a safe match.
suggestions.trade_off: Booking a named king room at the same properties costs more but actually meets the requirement. Expect roughly $100–$200/week more.

suggestions.title: Book Michelin-starred restaurants around verified schedules
suggestions.body: Start with the four currently starred restaurants, then fit other listings around their current service days and reservation availability. Recheck official restaurant calendars before choosing a date; hours can change.
suggestions.trade_off: Locking the starred nights first means the hotels must be chosen afterwards — the reverse of how people normally book.

suggestions.title: Choose transit passes only after mapping the actual rides
suggestions.body: RTC's current visitor Strip and All Access prices are $4 single ride, $6 for two hours, $8 for 24 hours, or $20 for three days. The Monorail currently offers a seven-day pass for $64 paper or $59.95 electronic. Compare fares against the routes you will actually use; they are separate systems.
suggestions.trade_off: The Monorail does not reach Chinatown or downtown, so RTC buses are still needed for roughly half the restaurant list. The pass is not a substitute for bus fares.

suggestions.title: Use the itinerary to reduce cross-town trips
suggestions.body: Group downtown and Arts District stops on one outing when it suits the opening hours and reservations. Route time estimates are planning aids, not guaranteed journey durations; verify live service and walking conditions on the day.
suggestions.trade_off: Choosing centre Strip (Cosmopolitan, ARIA, Bellagio, Vdara, Caesars) costs more per night than the Venetian in the March window, and gives up the in-building convenience of four restaurants under one roof.

suggestions.title: Budget from final checkout prices, not nightly averages
suggestions.body: The displayed direct hotel nightly averages are not tax-inclusive seven-night checkout totals. Room taxes, resort-fee treatment and room-category availability differ; use the hotel's final checkout screen and save the quote before booking.
suggestions.trade_off: It consumes a whole evening, so a starred dinner cannot happen that night. Slot it on arrival day.

suggestions.title: Recheck volatile details shortly before travel
suggestions.body: Confirm restaurant hours, attraction schedules, transit service and hotel room conditions against the linked official pages near the travel date. Changes after this capture cannot be predicted.
suggestions.trade_off: No downside; it is purely an accounting correction. The Wynn rows already show both bases side by side as a worked example.
